scripts.build: npm run build:static && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.watch: npm run build:static && concurrently "npm run watch:js" "npm run watch:css"
scripts.zip: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path '../extension-upload.zip') { Remove-Item '../extension-upload.zip' -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path (Get-ChildItem dist -Exclude *.map).FullName -DestinationPath '../extension-upload.zip'; Write-Host 'Created: ../extension-upload.zip'"
